description: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1/3 arc-second DEM. Public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). Illinois statewide LiDAR via Illinois Height Modernization (ILHMP); USGS 3DEP provides the federated access.

downloadedVsReferenced.demTiles: REFERENCED ONLY — 1-degree tiles via S3; not vendored.

limitations: 1/3 arc-second (~10m) resolution; higher-res ILHMP data via Illinois State Geological Survey.
